# Pronorm USA

> Pronorm USA is the United States home of Pronorm, a German manufacturer of fitted kitchens. Kitchens are built to order in Vlotho, Germany and sold, designed, and installed in the US by authorized independent dealers. Pronorm's main US difference is that base and tall cabinets ship at an American 24-inch (610 mm) depth as standard.

Pronorm USA is operated by European Kitchen Distributors (EKD), the exclusive US distributor of Pronorm. It is not a retailer: homeowners buy through an authorized dealer.

## Key facts

- Manufacturer: pronorm Einbauküchen GmbH, Vlotho, Eastern Westphalia, Germany. Building kitchens since 1972.
- Product lines: Y-line (handleless, integrated grip profile), X-line (handleless, C-shaped profile), Proline128 (handled, 128 mm grid). All three combine in one kitchen.
- US cabinet depth: 610 mm (24 in) base and tall cabinets as standard. The factory builds in millimeters.
- Manufacturing tolerance: 0.1 mm. Hardware: Blum, Hettich, Grass. Soft-close is standard.
- Fronts: over 100 options across matte and gloss lacquer, veneer, laminate, ceramic, and glass.
- Typical installed price: $40,000 to $150,000+, depending on size, line, and finish. Premium mid-range, below luxury brands such as SieMatic and Poggenpohl.
- Lead time: factory production typically 6 to 9 weeks, plus about 6 weeks ocean shipping.
- US showrooms: eleven authorized showrooms as of August 2026, in California, Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, and Washington. Dealer territories are protected.
- Certifications: Golden M, GS Tested Safety, PEFC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001. Climate-neutral manufacturing since 2021.
